crossSessionInbound.title: Inbound Cross-Session Messages
crossSessionInbound.description: How to handle SendMessage traffic from your other sessions on this machine: 'accept' delivers it, 'hold' parks it for your review in /peers without letting the model act, 'refuse' opts this session out. A repository's checked-in settings.json may only tighten it, and a 'hold' set there asks you per message rather than parking silently, because that is the repository's decision and not yours; your own settings.local.json is yours and carries no such limit. Unset means match the permission mode of the sending session.

MCPServerConfig.description: Definition of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration.

args.description: Command-line arguments for the stdio transport command.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the server process.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process.

url.description: URL for SSE or HTTP transport. Use with "type" field to specify transport type.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers sent to the server.

type.description: Transport type. Use "stdio" for local command, "sse" for Server-Sent Events, "http" (or "streamable-http") for Streamable HTTP, or "ws" for WebSocket.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP requests.

trust.description: Marks the server as trusted. Trusted servers may gain additional capabilities.

includeTools.description: Subset of tools that should be enabled for this server. When omitted all tools are enabled.

excludeTools.description: Tools that should be disabled for this server even if exposed.

toolOverrides.description: Optional model-surface overrides keyed by the raw MCP tool name.

exposedName.description: Tool name exposed to the model. Requires alwaysLoad to be true.

alwaysLoad.description: Keep this tool directly registered when MCP lazy loading is active.

extension.description: Metadata describing the Qwen Code extension that owns this MCP server.

oauth.description: OAuth configuration for authenticating with the server.

disabled.description: Whether the MCP server is disabled. When true, the server will not be started.

headersHelper.description: Shell command that prints a JSON object of HTTP headers to stdout. Executed at connection time to generate dynamic headers (for example short-lived auth tokens) that are merged on top of `headers`.

alwaysAllow.description: Tool names from this server that should bypass user confirmation.

deferred.description: Keep this server's tools out of model tool declarations. Agents with CodeMode find them with searchTools inside scripts; other agents use mcp_list/mcp_get/mcp_call. Tools with toolOverrides alwaysLoad stay declared.

SummarizeToolOutputSettings.description: Controls summarization behavior for individual tools. All properties are optional.

tokenBudget.description: Maximum number of tokens used when summarizing tool output.

AgentOverride.description: Override settings for a specific agent.

maxTimeMinutes.description: The maximum execution time for the agent in minutes.

maxTurns.description: The maximum number of conversational turns.

tools.description: Tool names available to the agent.

AutoThemePair.description: Themes to use for dark and light terminal backgrounds when `ui.theme` is `auto`. Either key may be omitted to keep its default.

dark.description: Theme to use on a dark terminal background. Defaults to `Default`.

light.description: Theme to use on a light terminal background. Defaults to `Default Light`.

CustomTheme.description: Custom theme definition used for styling Qwen Code output. Colors are provided as hex strings or named ANSI colors.

StringOrStringArray.description: Accepts either a single string or an array of strings.

StringOrFalse.description: Accepts either a string value or false.

modes.description: All thinking modes supported by the model.

preferredMode.description: Preferred mode when the model supports more than one thinking mode.

requiresBudgetForEnabled.description: Whether enabled thinking requires a fixed budget_tokens value. Inherits the built-in model's policy when omitted; otherwise defaults to true.

HookDefinitionArray.description: Array of hook definition objects for a specific event.

items.description: Hook definition specifying matcher pattern and hook configurations.

matcher.description: Pattern to match against the event context (tool name, notification type, etc.). Supports exact match, regex (/pattern/), and wildcards (*).

hooks.description: Hooks to execute when the matcher matches.

command.description: Shell command to execute. Receives JSON input via stdin and returns JSON output via stdout.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for hook execution.

if.description: Per-hook condition filter. Format: `"ToolName(arg_pattern)"` or `"ToolName"`. A trailing `:*` is treated as a prefix rule (e.g. `"Bash(git commit:*)"` matches `git commit` and `git commit -m ...`).

shell.description: Shell to use for command hooks: 'bash' or 'powershell'. Defaults to system shell.

args.description: Optional argv array for exec form. When set, the hook runs as spawn(command, args, { shell: false }) — no shell parses or quotes anything. 'shell' is ignored. Use this when paths or arguments contain shell metacharacters that would require complex quoting.

async.description: Run hook in the background without blocking the current operation.

asyncRewake.description: If true, hook runs in background and wakes the model on exit code 2 (blocking error). Implies async.

rewakeMessage.description: @internal Custom prefix for the system-reminder shown to the model when an asyncRewake hook exits with code 2. The hook output is appended after this prefix.

rewakeSummary.description: @internal One-line summary shown to the user in the terminal when an asyncRewake hook exits with code 2. Defaults to "Stop hook feedback".

statusMessage.description: Custom status message for spinner/status line display while the hook runs.

once.description: Remove the hook from the registry after its first successful execution. Only effective for session-scoped hooks.
